correctness.rationale: PASS. Reconstructed the generalized eigenvalue equation (L u)_m=lambda m_m u_m, where L=2I-shift-shift*, m=1 outside the three defects and 1-delta on them. For lambda>4, write lambda=2+q+1/q, 0<q<1. Free resolvent kernel is (-q)^{|i-j|}/(q^-1-q); the symmetric Birman–Schwinger/Green matrix on the three defects is diagonal-conjugate to ((1+q)/(1-q)) times the positive 3x3 Toeplitz matrix with t=q^d and entries [1,t,t^2;t,1,t;t^2,t,1]. Its channels are exactly mu_+=(2+t^2+t sqrt(8+t^2))/2, mu_odd=1-t^2 and mu_-=(2+t^2-t sqrt(8+t^2))/2. Monotonicity of lambda(lambda-L)^-1 and limits at lambda down to 4 give inverse-deficit thresholds 0,4d,4d/3, hence three strict mode regions with equality non-normalizable at the band edge. Independent symbolic second-order expansions of delta=1/[((1+q)/(1-q))mu_j] around q=1 produce derivatives 1/4 and 1/12 for the two emerging channels, and lambda-4=(1-q)^2/q; therefore coefficients 16,144. Computed for d=1,2,5 without relying on package verify.py. Finite-chain Sturm calculations from package are supplementary; finite intervals or eigenvalue approximations are not infinite completeness proofs. Scope excludes stiffness changes, damping, nonlinear contacts and arbitrary defect arrangements.
